description: The street appears to have narrow, continuous sidewalks on both sides with a mostly smooth surface, set back from the roadway by a curb and a strip of grass/trees. There is no visible physical barrier separating pedestrians from traffic beyond the curb, but the road is wide with low apparent traffic and a centerline, while mature trees provide substantial shade and some comfort; streetlights are present along the corridor. No obvious curb ramps, crosswalks, or sidewalk obstructions are visible in this view.
